dedupe_keys.name: comprehensive heat indices chi global hourly dataset 1950 to 2024

description: The Comprehensive Heat Indices dataset gives 13 heat stress indices, such as the Universal Thermal Climate Index and the heat index, as hourly global grids at 0.1 degree resolution from 1950 to 2024, computed from ERA5 and ERA5-Land reanalysis between 60 degrees south and 75 degrees north. It is described by Malik and others in Scientific Data (16 January 2026). The data are about 73 TB in 11,700 monthly NetCDF files and are hosted in the KAUST Datawaha repository, downloadable through Globus after sign-in; the user guide and metadata are available free on figshare under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: indices inherit reanalysis biases and are not validated against observations for every index, and the full archive is very large. It supports studies of heat effects on power demand, rail and road assets, outdoor work and health services with consistent extreme heat hazard series; a related record is the ERA5 reanalysis.
